2. 'Structural collapse (Feed horn supports)': Router severity 2.0. I agree. The struts lack clear mechanical connection points (bolts/welds) and seem to fuse into the mesh. This is a significant structural ambiguity.
3. 'Perspective distortion (Brick windows)': Router severity 1.0. I agree. The ellipses are slightly irregular, indicating weak geometric grounding in the architectural elements.
